Clever improvisers who solve problems through wit, deception and perfectly-timed chaos.

SKILLS

READY HANDS · SL max 2

Once per scene, gain (SL) IP after you spend a Fabula Point to alter the current situation or the story,

FIELD IMPROVISATION · SL max 2

When you perform the Inventory action to produce an item, you may produce a second, different item that has a total IP cost of (4 − SL) or greater: Treat both uses as if they were the same action, combine their associated costs, and merge the effects of the resulting items. If they are somehow incompatible, resolve them one by one instead.

PATTER · SL max 3

When you erase or mark segments of a Clock thanks to your lies or sense of humor, roll (SL) d3 and choose one of them: If it's a 1, erase 1 segment from the clock; if it's a 3, mark 1 segment from the clock.

WHOOPS!

Before performing a Check, you may declare it as a Fumble due to a clumsy accident or silly coincidence. You cannot do this on Checks that may not generate Opportunities, such as Support Checks. You gain Fabula Points as normal as part of this Fumble, and you and the GM must agree on which Opportunity you generate.

Additionally, choose a creature whenever you get a Fumble: They recover 10 MP.

WITTY REMARK · SL max 3

During a Conflict Scene and when you perform a Check against a creature that can hear you, you may spend up to (SL × 5) MP and speak out an insult or remark. If it's relevant to one of that creature's Traits, add a +1 bonus to your Check for every 5 MP you spent.
